NONE: › used in writing to represent the sound that people make when they are pausing or deciding what to say next
呃，嗯（表示說話中間停頓或考慮下文的象聲詞）

example: "What do you think of this jacket?" "Um, I don't know if I like the colour."
「你覺得這件夾克怎麽樣？」「呃，我不知道是否喜歡這種顔色。」
"So what did you talk about?" "Um, I don't remember."
「那麽你們談了些甚麽？」「嗯，我不記得了。」
